turns.content: The target is 2-methylhexan-1-ol and the final workup is H2O2/OH-. Reason backward from the terminal alcohol: which precursor functional group and reaction family make that workup chemically integral?
Starting from 2-methylhex-1-ene, compare BH3/THF followed by basic peroxide with Pt/H2. Predict each product and derive the relevant regiochemistry.

Now start from 2-methylhexanal and examine the same reagent possibilities. Which transformations could form an alcohol, and in which route is the stated peroxide workup actually responsible for installing oxygen?
Use those product predictions to select the substrate and first-stage reagent set that lead to the target after H2O2/OH-. State the complete two-stage transformation.
Trace the relevant atoms through the selected transformation and explain why the other substrate-reagent pairings fail the stated two-stage criterion.
Report the selected substrate and reagent sequence, explaining the positional outcome in the product.
